responsibility: This is the generated Texinfo form of the libgccjit manual. It packages the tutorial, API reference, C++ bindings, and internals documentation into the installable info/dvi/pdf input consumed by GCC’s documentation build rules, so it is the generated publication artifact for libgccjit documentation rather than handwritten implementation logic.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/jit/libgccjit.h and gcc/jit/libgccjit.cc, this same-stem file is not the API declaration or implementation; it is the generated Texinfo manual under docs/_build/texinfo that documents libgccjit, including references to those interfaces and tutorials.
